root_cause.text: In the async crypto completion callback `esp_output_done`, the return value of `esp_output_tail_tcp` was not checked, so when the espintcp TX queue was full and `esp_output_tail_tcp` returned an error without freeing the skb, the skb was leaked (unlike the synchronous path where the caller drops the skb on error).
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds error handling: it captures `err` from `esp_output_tail_tcp` and calls `kfree_skb(skb)` if `err != -EINPROGRESS`. The commit message states: "With async crypto (esp_output_done), we need to drop the skb when esp_output_tail_tcp returns an error."
